name: Protection for Children
arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَوِّذُ الحَسَنَ وَالحُسَينَ رضي الله عنهما ((أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ)).

transliterations.latin: Uidhukuma bi kelimatil-lahit-tammeh, min kul-li shejtanin ve hammeh, ve min kul-li ajnin ve lameh

translations.albanian: Lus Allahun që t’ju mbrojë me fjalët e tija të plota nga çdo shejtan, nga çdo dyshim i tij dhe prej çdo syri të keq.
translations.english: (Ibn AAabbas related that the Messenger of Allah  used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah’s protection, saying:(I commend you two to the protection of Allah’s perfect words from every devil, vermin, and every evil eye.))
translations.indonesian: Ya Allah! Tidak ada kemudahan kecuali apa yang Engkau jadikan mudah. Sedang yang susah bisa Engkau jadikan mudah, apabila Engkau menghendakinya.
